instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to plug the data shard into his deck and crack its contents, but the page offers only movement, speech, and item hand-off verbs (depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, refuse), and every available end state (holding an item, being in a room, having said something, knowing a location or holder) models none of that. Even the closest end state, glitch holding data-shard, would only cover getting the shard from Rogue, not plugging it in or cracking it, so no listed end state is what the instruction wants.
